body:
### Describe the bug

Getting exception while trying below code - 

```
        with op.batch_alter_table("<table_name>") as batch_op:

            batch_op.create_check_constraint(
                "ck_ssl_mode",
                "ssl_mode IN ('allow', 'prefer', 'require', 'disable', \
                'verify-ca', 'verify-full')"
            )
```

### To Reproduce

```python
with op.batch_alter_table("<table_name>") as batch_op:

            batch_op.create_check_constraint(
                "ck_ssl_mode",
                "ssl_mode IN ('allow', 'prefer', 'require', 'disable', \
                'verify-ca', 'verify-full')"
            )
```
